name: vendor thinking (t1.0/p0.95)
why: Thinking-arm profile. The measured greedy pick that preceded this one did not terminate: the arm projected 44h and stopped at the ceiling with 2 of the first 5 tasks capped at 31999 tokens and no answer, traces cut off mid-sentence. Zhipu's recommendation for GLM-4.7-Flash is temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, and they note it is generally not advisable to change temperature and top_p together, so top_k and min_p are left alone. The greedy pick was not careless -- it was measured, but at budget 8000, where a spiral is truncated into something indistinguishable from a legitimate cap. Tuning below the budget the run actually uses cannot detect non-termination, which is why the same mistake was made independently for qwen3.8-27b. Retries are set to 0 for this arm rather than 2. The cost here is the retry multiplier, not the budget: GLM decodes at 43 tok/s and answers most tasks in seconds, but a full 32000-token attempt costs 12.4 min, so 2 retries turn every non-terminating task into 37 minutes and the arm into 46h. At 0 retries the same arm is ~11h. The price is that a task whose trace leaves no answer scores as a failure with no second chance -- which is the honest reading of a configuration that will not answer, and avoids the hotter-resample confound that makes Gemma's thinking arm non-comparable to its own off arm. OFF ARM IS UNAFFECTED: it runs with B4_PROFILES='{}' (greedy) for every model, so this file changes the thinking arm only and the off-arm scores stay comparable across the tier.
